_meta.title: Metadata -> missingness-mechanism prior benchmark (Lacuna metadata-prior bakeoff)
_meta.purpose: Each row is the metadata an analyst already has for a column (name + codebook description + dataset domain). The task: from metadata ALONE (no data values), infer the prior over the missingness mechanism a competent analyst would hold. This benchmarks whether a LOCAL model can author that prior as well as a human/frontier model would.
_meta.denominator_note: Gold is the DOMINANT mechanism the metadata implies for missingness in that column (an analyst's prior), not a measured fact about a specific dataset. Where a column has mixed sources (e.g. a random-subsample lab that is also LOD-censored), gold = the source that dominates missingness across the full sample, with the mixture noted.

grounding_values.strong: real structural ground truth (published LOD flag, explicit skip-logic, randomized/by-design administration, structural ID) — defensible beyond opinion
grounding_values.consensus: textbook/expert consensus (e.g. sensitive items are self-censored); matches the Lacuna survey anchors
grounding_values.weak: plausible analyst prior but genuinely arguable; included to probe over-confidence
grounding_values.abstain: metadata genuinely underdetermines the mechanism; the correct behaviour is low confidence / indeterminate

columns.description: Blood lead concentration (ug/dL), laboratory assay.
columns.note: NHANES reports a companion below-limit-of-detection comment flag (LBDBPBLC); values under the analytic LOD are not observed = detection-limit MNAR.

columns.description: Blood cadmium concentration (ug/L), laboratory assay.
columns.note: Below-LOD values censored (LBDBCDLC flag).

columns.description: Blood total mercury (ug/L), laboratory assay.
columns.note: Detection-limit censoring.

columns.description: Serum cotinine (ng/mL), a biomarker of tobacco exposure, laboratory assay.
columns.note: Low exposures fall below the assay LOD = detection-limit MNAR.

columns.description: Urinary mono-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate metabolite (ng/mL), measured in a random urine subsample.
columns.note: Below-LOD censoring among the measured; the subsample non-selection is a separate MCAR source (mixture).

columns.description: High-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (ng/L); values below the assay limit of quantitation are reported as undetectable.
columns.note: Assay LOQ censoring at the low end.

columns.description: HIV-1 RNA plasma viral load (copies/mL); results below the assay threshold are returned as 'target not detected'.
columns.note: Below-threshold = undetectable; classic detection-limit MNAR.

columns.description: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D (nmol/L), immunoassay with a lower limit of quantitation.
columns.note: LOQ censoring at low concentrations.

columns.description: Serum PCB congener 74, lipid-adjusted (ng/g lipid), trace environmental contaminant assay.
columns.note: Trace contaminants routinely fall below LOD.

columns.description: Ratio of family income to the federal poverty guideline.
columns.note: Derived from income; income non-response is concentrated at the extremes (high and especially zero/low) = self-censoring. Matches the Lacuna income anchor consensus.

columns.description: Total annual household income (category).
columns.note: Sensitive financial disclosure; refusal is value-dependent at both tails.

columns.description: Respondent's total annual household income in US dollars.
columns.note: Canonical self-censoring item; non-response concentrated at extremes.

columns.description: Ever used marijuana or hashish (yes/no), drug-use questionnaire.
columns.note: Stigmatised illicit behaviour; non-disclosure depends on the answer.

columns.description: Ever used cocaine, heroin, or methamphetamine (yes/no).
columns.note: Highly stigmatised; self-censoring.

columns.description: Over the last 2 weeks, how often bothered by feeling down, depressed, or hopeless (PHQ-9 depression screener item).
columns.note: Mental-health disclosure; matches the Lacuna depression anchor.

columns.description: Over the last 2 weeks, how often bothered by thoughts you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself (PHQ-9 suicidal-ideation item).
columns.note: Extremely sensitive; strong self-censoring.

columns.description: Self-reported current weight (pounds), weight-history questionnaire.
columns.note: Self-reported (not measured) weight; non-response and mis-report are value-dependent. Matches the Lacuna weight anchor.

columns.description: Which candidate the respondent voted for in the most recent national election.
columns.note: Socially-sensitive; non-response correlates with the (socially less-acceptable) choice.

columns.description: Respondent's self-reported body weight in kilograms.
columns.note: Body-weight disclosure is value-dependent.

columns.description: Average number of cigarettes smoked per day now. Asked only of respondents who reported currently smoking.
columns.note: Missing-by-design: presence is fully determined by an observed smoking-status gate = MAR/by-design.

columns.description: Do you now smoke cigarettes? Asked only of respondents who reported having smoked at least 100 cigarettes in their life.
columns.note: Gated on an observed screener (SMQ020).

columns.description: Have you ever been pregnant? Asked only of female respondents.
columns.note: Missingness fully explained by observed sex = MAR/by-design.

columns.description: Number of cigarettes smoked per day, asked only of respondents who reported being current smokers.
columns.note: Explicit skip-logic gate.

columns.description: How many months pregnant, asked only of respondents who answered yes to being currently pregnant.
columns.note: Gated on an observed yes/no item.

columns.description: Age when first child was born, asked only of respondents who reported having one or more children.
columns.note: Gated on an observed has-children item.

columns.description: Number of coronary bypass grafts, recorded only for patients who underwent a coronary artery bypass procedure.
columns.note: Present only conditional on an observed procedure flag.

columns.description: Reason for dissatisfaction, shown only to respondents who rated satisfaction below 3 of 5.
columns.note: Branch gated on an observed rating.

columns.description: A mathematics test item that appears only in a subset of the rotated test booklets; each student is randomly assigned a booklet.
columns.note: Planned-missing rotated-booklet design: presence is randomised and value-independent = MCAR-by-design. This is the documented Stage-E footprint blind spot the prior fixes.

columns.description: Serum perfluorooctanoic acid (ng/mL), an environmental chemical measured only in a randomly selected one-third subsample of participants.
columns.note: Across the full sample, missingness is dominated by random subsample non-selection = MCAR-by-design (below-LOD censoring among the measured is a secondary MNAR source).

columns.description: A question administered to a randomly selected half of respondents (split-questionnaire / matrix-sampling design).
columns.note: Random half-sample assignment = MCAR-by-design.

columns.description: Fasting plasma glucose (mg/dL), measured only on participants assigned to the morning examination session (fasting subsample), who are selected by design.
columns.note: Morning-session/fasting-subsample selection is by design; dominant missingness source is the planned subsample, treated as MCAR-by-design.

columns.description: A reading item present only on test form C; forms are randomly spiraled across test-takers.
columns.note: Random spiraling of forms = value-independent planned missingness.

columns.description: Respondent sequence number (unique participant identifier).
columns.note: Structural identifier; effectively never missing and value-independent.

columns.description: Unique row/record identifier assigned at data entry.
columns.note: Administrative key.

columns.description: Calendar date on which the interview was conducted.
columns.note: Administrative timestamp; missingness usually clerical/value-independent (arguable).

columns.description: Interview and examination status flag (interviewed only vs interviewed and MEC-examined).
columns.note: Structural status code; governs downstream block missingness rather than being meaningfully missing itself.

columns.description: Survey wave / data-release cycle identifier.
columns.note: Administrative metadata.

columns.description: Age in years at the time of screening.
columns.note: Near-complete core demographic; acts as a MAR predictor. If missing, typically administrative — included to probe over-claiming.

columns.description: Gender of the participant.
columns.note: Core demographic, near-complete; MAR-driver role.

columns.description: Highest level of education completed.
columns.note: Demographic predictor; missingness mostly covariate-associated (arguable, mild sensitivity).

columns.description: Standing height (cm), measured during the physical examination.
columns.note: Measured (not self-reported); missing mainly when the exam component was not done = MAR on examination status (not value-driven).

columns.description: Systolic blood pressure (mmHg), first seated reading.
columns.note: Routine vital; missingness driven by visit type/protocol, not by the BP value itself.

columns.description: LDL cholesterol (mg/dL), standard lipid panel.
columns.note: Ordered based on clinical indication (observable context) more than on the value = MAR-leaning.

columns.description: No description available.
columns.note: Cryptic, undocumented column: metadata gives no basis for a mechanism prior. Correct behaviour is to abstain.

columns.description: Numeric feature, no further documentation.
columns.note: No semantic content; abstain.

columns.description: Composite score, item 12 (no scale description provided).
columns.note: Underdetermined; abstain.

columns.description: Binary flag, meaning not documented.
columns.note: Opaque flag; abstain.

columns.description: Free-text 'other (please specify)' field accompanying a closed-ended question.
columns.note: Could be skip-gated, sparse, or sensitive depending on the parent item; metadata alone underdetermines it.

columns.description: An unspecified instrument measurement.
columns.note: Sensor data could be detection-limited (MNAR) or dropout (MAR/MCAR); without specifics, abstain.
